spike_plan.kill_if: Offline build fails with the vendored set, or the sheet varies between runs, or the spec cannot be fixed to a stable output format.
spike_plan.pass_if: Build finishes offline within about 30 min; the CLI baseline matches the spec; the 20-case sheet is identical across three runs.
steps: In a throwaway networked Linux container, clone astral-sh/uv at 2b50cbc0 and run cargo build --release --locked for the uv binary; time it and record the vendored-crate situation for --offline.

Run uv cache dir, uv python dir, uv tool dir, uv cache size, uv cache clean --help and uv cache prune --help to confirm the per-kind commands and whether --dry-run exists; record the output as the baseline.
Confirm whether a top-level uv clean command exists in this build; if not, fix the spec name to uv cache clean.
Write a 20-case spec sheet (listing text, JSON keys, exit codes, dry-run no-op, size totals) on temp dirs with fake tool and Python directories; run each case three times to check determinism.
Check that the reference-free image can run a targeted local test set in under 10 minutes, so agents do not rely on the full suite.

v1.summary: The repo, Apache-2.0 licence and open issue #11360 are real, but the issue only asks for a directory listing and config entries, while size accounting, uv clean and dry-run are our extension and the seed's `uv clean` and `uv self dirs` names do not appear upstream. No kill, but the title should be corrected to `uv cache clean` and the output format should be pinned in the spec before any build.

v2.note: Killed (K8). uv already has per-kind dir commands (cache/python/tool/auth dir, cache size), so `uv dirs` mostly combines existing helpers. Issue #11360 contradicts the claimed scope: size accounting, clean targets and dry-run are our own additions, and the output format is prose-only, so hidden tests would reject reasonable alternatives (K3 risk as well). The upstream suite timed out three times and was nondeterministic (2972 failures, 13 flaky), so it cannot serve as a regression gate or self-check without major build work.
